tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na'i bsgrub pa byed tshul bzhugs so// oṃ swasti shrī dza yan+tu/ na mo gu ru mañju nā thā ya/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag gi spyi bo 'og min bde chen dbus/ /ut+pal nags tshal nyams dga' bsil zer steng / /bla ma 'jam dbyangs ye shes nyi ma shar/ /dri med gsung gi bdud rtsi'i dga' ston gyis/ /mkha' mnyam sems can bdag sogs 'gro ba kun/ /gti mug mun sel shes rgyud sgrib sbyangs nas/ /blo gros spobs pa'i gnang ba stsol mdzad gang / /rje btsun sa lo 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud/ /de mnyes byed pa'i bsnyen bsgrub rim pa yi/ /phyag len nyams su blang tshul go bde'i phyir/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal rje btsun gong ma'i gsung / /legs par btus te cung zad bri bar bya// //'dir rje btsun sa skya pa'i shes rab 'phel ba'i gdams pa zab mo 'jam dpal rnon por grags pa 'di nyid bsgrub pa la/ yid ches shing khungs btsun pa'i phyir lo rgyus cung zad brjod na/ sngon gyi dus rgya gar shar phyogs na rdo rje slob dpon paṇ+ḍi ta chen po grub pa'i dbang phyug zhig bzhugs pa la sras gcig byung ba de/ blo sbyong gi grwa sar btang bas/ de dag na re/ khyod kyi pha tshogs 'khor byed zer sha chang la longs spyod pa'i rigs ngan yin pas 'dir ma 'dug par song gleng ba dang / pha'i gam du log ste lo rgyus brjod pas mi lto yis/ 'di'i bsgrub pa gyis shig gsung nas/ 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang dang sgrub thabs kyi lung gnang ste bsgrub pas zla ba drug nas 'grub pa'i rtags ljags spyil la me 'bar ba/ de'i nye logs na ma yod pas blos ma gzod par chu gtor nas me bsad pas/ pha na re bar chad byas pas tshe 'dir ma thob ste/ bar dor phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro/ /gsung zhing lung bstan brnyes pa'i sras de ni slob dpon dze tā ri dgra las rnam par rgyal ba yin te/

byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa a ra pa tsa na dang dngos su mjal nas gdams pa mnos so/ /dze tā ri la rdo rje gdan pa chen po/ de la rdo rje gdan pa chung ba/ de la ba ri lo tsā ba/ de la bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ de la slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ de la rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ de la sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis gsan te/ de dag thams cad kyi 'jam dpal zhal gzigs pa yin te/ yid ches pa'i gtan tshigs du ma snang zhing / khyad par rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sa skya pa chen po dgung lo bcu gnyis bzhes pa'i dus su/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po ba ri lo tsā ba la chos gsan pas/ ba ri ba'i zhal nas khyod sa skya pa'i jo sras yin pas slob gnyer byed dgos shing / de la shes rab dgos pas/ rje btsun 'jam dpal gyi bsgrub pa gyis shig gsungs nas 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang dang sgrub thabs sogs kyis lung gnang / bla ma nyid kyis kyang bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzad nas sa skya'i gzim khang rnying pa shar nub gnyis kyi bla brang shar gyi rdo rje phug par bsgrub pa mdzad pas bar chad kyi cho 'phrul cung zad byung ba la/ mi g.yo ba sngon po'i bsgom bzlas dang sngags bzlas pas bar chad zhi ste/ zla ba drug nas mdun gyi nam mkhar 'phags pa 'jam dpal rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa/ 'khor byang sems gnyis dang bcas pa zhal gzigs te/ mgon po 'jam dbyangs kyi zhal nas/ tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa min/ /'khor ba la zhen na nges 'byung min/ /bdag don la zhen na byang sems min/ /'dzin pa byung na lta ba min/ /zhes zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams pa gnang ba'o/ /de ltar rim pas brgyud de sa lo chen po kun dga'i mtshan can gyi bar du byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams par byon pa'i yid ches dang byin rlabs gnyis ka ldan pa'i rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsgrub par 'dod pas/

dben zhing yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims rnam pa gsum la gnas shing / rig pa 'dzin pa'i gang zag gis/ sha chang bud med sogs mi gtsang ba dang / 'bags pa ma lus pa spangs nas khrus dang gtsang sbra phun sum tshogs pa byas te/ srab mo'i stan nang tshangs can la rdo rje'i skyil krung ngam/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis 'dug la/ khrus ma grub na kha bshal nas/ skyabs 'gro spyi dang mthun pa ji ltar rigs pa byas la/ bdag gi sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi bsgom bzlas zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum gyis byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ rang gi snying sgo nga lta bu'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i steng du dhīḥyig dmar ser de las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sangs rgyas byang sems kyi bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na mo mañju gho ṣā ya bh+yaḥ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchis sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ rang gi snying sgo nga stong pa lta bu'i nang gi dhīḥyig las 'od 'phros/ lus kyi nang gang bas thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang mi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad bcom/ tha mal gyi lus bsregs sbyangs/ dri ma med pa shel gong g.ya' dag pa lta bur gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil gyi dbus su dhīḥyig gser btso ma'i mdog can de las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal nas/ yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba la bkod/

bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi byin brlabs thams cad bsdus nas rang gi sems dhīḥyig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog dmar ser gur gum gzhon nu'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas pas mi shes pa gcod par byed pa'i shes rab kyi ral gri phyar zhing / g.yon pas ut+pa la'i yu ba bzung nas snyan gyi thad sor kha bye ba'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang / dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thab can/ dbu skra ral pa'i cod paṇa spyi bor bcings shing / zur phud lnga g.yon du 'phyang ba/ snyan gong ut+pal dar dpyangs kyi brgyan pa/ gzhon nu lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu/ zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba'i steng du shes rab kyi 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar dbus su dhīḥ g.yas su oṃ/ g.yon du a/ rtsibs bzhi la mdun nas brtsams te g.yas bskor du ra pa tsa na zhes gnas pa'i dhīḥlas 'od 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ rang gi snying kha'i shes rab kyi 'khor lo sngags phreng dang bcas pa rin chen sgron me ltar rab tu 'od 'bar bar bsam la de las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib las ngan gti mug gi dri ma sbyangs te 'jam dpal gyi skur gyur/

'od zer gyi sne la mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad la mchod pa phul bas mnyes te 'od zer tshur 'dus pa'i tshe/ de dag gi mkhyen brtse nus gsum byin rlabs thams cad sngags phreng dang 'od zer ser po'i rnam par byung nas shes rab kyi 'khor lo'i yig 'bru rnams la thim pas shes rgyud kyi sdig sgrib dag bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlabs par bsam la yid rtse gcig pas ma yengs par gong gi dmigs pa gsal gang thebs kyi ngang nas/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ ces pa grangs bzung la bzla/ thun bsdu ba dang rang gi lce'i steng du dhīḥdamar ser mgo gre phugs su bstan nas nyal stabs su gnas pa las dhīḥyig dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ lus kyi nang gang bas mi shes pa'i mun pa thams cad bsal nas/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can rgyud la skyes par bsam la dbugs thang gcig la dhīḥbargya rtsa brgyad bzla/ de ltar ma thon na'ang ngag bcad de bzlas pas rang gi lus dhīḥyig 'od 'bar zhing gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur pa'i mos pa byas la/ phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bzung nas/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal te bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ zhes dang / phreng ba la kha rlangs phog par byas rang gi spyi bor bzhag pas sngags kyi nus pa thim par bsam/ de nas oṃ ār+ya mañju shrī sa pa ri bā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta ā hūm̐/ gang gi blo gros sgrib gnyis sprin bral nyi ltar rnam dag rab gsal ba/ /ji snyed don kun ji bzhin gzigs phyir nyid kyi thugs khar glegs bam 'dzin/ /gang dag srid pa'i btson rar ma rig mun 'thoms sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i/

/'gro tshogs kun la bu gcig ltar brtse yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan gsung / /'brug ltar ches sgrog nyon mongs gnyid slong las kyi lcags sgrog 'grol mdzad cing / /ma rig mun sel sdug bsngal myu gu ji snyed gcod mdzad ral gri bsnams/ /gdod nas dag cing sa bcu'i mthar son yon tan lus rdzogs rgyal sras thu bo'i sku/ /bcu phrag bcu dang bcu gnyis rgyan spras bdag blo'i mun sel 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud/ /gang tshe lta bar 'dod pa'am/ /cung zad bri bar 'dod na yang / /mgon po 'jam dbyangs de nyid ni/ /gegs med par ni mthong bar shog /brtse ldan khyod kyi mkhyen pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /bdag blo'i gti mug mun pa rab bsal nas/ /bka' dang bstan bcos gzhung lugs rtogs pa yi/ /blo gros spobs pa'i snang ba stsal du gsol/ /shes pas srid la mi gnas shing / /snying rje zhi la mi gnas pa/ /'khor ba myang 'das gnyis med pa'i/ /'jam dbyangs thugs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /phyi ma byang chub ma thob bar/ /bcom ldan 'jam dbyangs khyed nyid kyi/ /bdag gi bla ma mdzad du gsol/ /gang gi mkhyen rab nyi ma stong bas kyang / /ches cher gsal bas 'gro ba'i ma rig pa/ /drung nas 'byin mdzad lha mchog 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /bdag gi snying la rgyun du 'jug gyur cig /gdong bzhi gdong gi pad tshal gyi/ /ngang pa'i bu mo thams cad dkar/ /dbyangs can ma de'ang kho bo yi/ /yid la ring du rol bar mdzod/ /dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yis sa la 'god par shog /ces mchod cing bstod de dge ba bsngo ba'o/ /de ltar g.yengs pas mi 'grub/ mdor na sems rtse gcig tu thun bzhi'i nges pas sngags ngag bcad nas shin tu dag par bzla'o/ /dus zla ba drug gam 'bum phrag brgyad bzlas pas thog mar 'dzin blo skye bar 'gyur/

de nas 'gran zla med pa'i snyan mngags mkhan dang / rdo rje'i ngag dang / phyin ci ma log pa/ don phun sum tshogs pa skyes nas de'i mod la tshig bcad brgya byed cing smra bar 'gyur ro/ /grub pa'i ltas ni rmi lam du ral gri dang / ut+pal 'dzin pa dang / dge slong sngon po dang phrad pa/ mi sha dang dkar gsum za ba/ spyil po la me 'bar ba'am me phung chen po mthong ba/ nam mkha' la 'phur ba sogs rmi ba'am/ dngos su byung na grub nye ba'i rtags su shes par bya'o/ /bar chad kyi las ni thog ser 'bab pa/ stag dang seṅge la sogs pa gcan gzan gdug pa can gyis zos pa/ rlung gis khyer ba'am tshubs ma chen po mthong ba/ bud med nag mo khros pas brdeg pa dang / chus khyer ba sogs rmi na bar chad kyi bltas yin pas khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba bsgom nas sngags brgya rtsa bzlas pas bsrung bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes gnang ni sgrub thabs rgya mtsho bzhin sku gsung thugs kyi chings dang ldan pa thob nas/ bsgom bzlas ni/ sa lo nyid kyis mdzad pa 'di nyams su blang ngo / /de brjod na/ na maḥ.ār+yā tsa lā ya/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba bsgom par 'dod pas stan bde ba la skyil krung bcas nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang mthun par byas te/ rang skad cig gis 'phags pa mi g.yo bar gsal ba'i snying khar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa mi g.yo ba la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥ.ār+yā tsa la sa pa ri wā ra bh+yaḥ oṃ ār+yā tsa la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ di paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig

/sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig /oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃḥ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du rang gi sems hūm̐ sngon po gcig tu gyur/ de las 'od 'phros sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin rlabs nus mthu bsdus nas hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid skad cig gis rje btsun mi g.yo ba sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pas ye shes kyi ral gri me 'bar ba nam mkha' la phyar ba/ g.yon pas thugs khar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa la rdo rje zhags pa dkris pa'i sne mo lcag gong du 'phyar ba/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa'i ya sos ma mchu mnan pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa'i g.yas pa steng du gzigs pas lha'i bu'i bdud tshar gcod cing / g.yon pa 'og tu gzigs pas klu dang sa bdag 'joms pa/ dbus ma thad kar gzigs pas dgra bgegs phra mo tshar gcod pa/ klu gnyan sa bdag dbang du 'dus pa'i brdar/ sbrul dkar pos se ral khar byas pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan zhing / dar sna tshogs pa'i sham thab can/ dbu skra nag po ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa/ zhabs g.yon pa'i pus mo gdan la btsugs shing / g.yas pa bzhengs stabs su mdzad pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i dbus su ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra mtshon gang ba'i thugs khar nyi ma la ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ sngon po nas 'bru tsam de las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad khro bo mi g.yo ba'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/

yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃḥ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ badz+rī bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ḥ zhes gsung shing dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ rang gi snying kha'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mtha' mar sngags kyi bskor ba las 'od 'phros sems can rnams kyis sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad sbyangs/ bla ma yi dam gyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs nus mthu rang la thim par bsam nas/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la bdud bzhi'i bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang / mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /mi g.yo mgon po 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces pa 'di ni don gnyer dag gis bskul ba'i ngor/ dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dpal sa skyar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni zla ba grags pa'o/ /zhes pa 'di bzhin nyams su blang ste bar chad kyi rmi lam ngan pa bzlog par bya'o/ /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi bsgrub pa byed tshul 'di ni rigs dang chos kyi bu rnams la phan par bsam ste/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma dang / sa paṇa dang sa lo chen pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bzhin las cung zad gsung sgros kyi brgyan te/ mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag sa lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa chos med snyoms las mkhan ri khrid pa sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis dben gnas byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong du sug bris bgyis pa 'di la nyes pa mchis na/

sa lo chen po'i drung du bzod par gsol lo/ /brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung du gsol/ 'di bris dge bas bdag sogs sems can rnams/ /bla ma rje btsun 'jam dbyangs thugs rje yis/ /mi shes mun bsal bdag med rtogs pa yi/ /dngos grub stsal zhing myur du sangs rgyas shog/ //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub pa byed tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
